cohort: The study included 75 premature newborns admitted to the hospital's Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) between November 1, 2019, and December 31, 2021.
finding: Lung ultrasound (LUS) significantly outperforms chest X-ray (CXR) for bedside assessment of lung consolidation and interstitial edema in premature newborns, showing a higher detection rate for both conditions.
